**知识梳理**

1**、利用导数研究不等式恒成立问题的求解策略：**

（1）通常要构造新函数，利用导数研究函数的单调性，求出最值，从而求出参数的取值范围；

（2）利用可分离变量，构造新函数，直接把问题转化为函数的最值问题；

（3）根据恒成立或有解求解参数的取值时，一般涉及分离参数法，但压轴试题中很少碰到分离参数后构造的新函数能直接求出最值点的情况，进行求解，若参变分离不易求解问题，就要考虑利用分类讨论法和放缩法，注意恒成立与存在性问题的区别．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

当时， 在上递减，在上递增，则，

由

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

因为，

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

当，即时，则需，解得.

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

综上所述，的取值范围是.

**[方法二]【最优解】：特值辅助法**

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

令，，当时，，单调递减；当时，，单调递增，∴，∴当时在内恒成立；

由在内恒成立，由(\*)知，∴，∴，解得.

**[方法二]：判别式法**

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

由，从而对任意的有恒成立，等价于对任意的①，恒成立．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

（事实上，直线为函数的图像在处的切线）

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

同理对任意的恒成立，即等价于对任意的恒成立．    ②

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

当时，将①式看作一元二次方程，进而有，①式的解为或（不妨设）；

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

当时，，从而或，又，从而成立；

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

当时，由①式得或，又，所以．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

当时，将②式看作一元二次方程，进而有．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

由，得，此时②式的解为不妨设，从而．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

综上所述，．

**[方法三]【最优解】：反证法**

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

假设存在，使得满足条件的*m*，*n*有．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

因为，所以．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

因为，所以．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

因为对恒成立，所以有

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

．则有

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

，   ③

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

，    ④

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

解得．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

由③+④并化简得，．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

因为在区间上递增，且，

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

所以，．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

由对恒成立，即有    ⑤

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

对恒成立，将⑤式看作一元二次方程，进而有．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

设，则，

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

所以在区间上递减，所以，即．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

设不等式⑤的解集为，则，这与假设矛盾．从而．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)

由均为偶函数．同样可证时，也成立．

![](images/5e383d1d45b7de4b9fa9143e4e9ea41713e055a9d72ac00614059c40393f341c.jpg)
